h: Human Reverence Opens the Way to Divine Love

p: (בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא, חֵלֶק ג פב, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
(in the Raaya Mehemna, III 82a, at the end):
that honor is a positive commandment
there is mentioned there the matter of "we will do and we will hear,"
"we will do" is a positive commandment,
but what has "we will hear" to do
"Why are Yisrael compared to an apple tree?
why does it call "we will hear" leaves?
it is because study is not the main thing
and this is what they sent from there:
It is clear that the fruit
and the leaves are called the unlearned.
And it says in the holy Zohar
the Holy One, blessed be He, the Torah and Yisrael;
and each one is hidden and revealed, etc."
And it explains there the pasuk (Tehillim 147:19):
His statutes and ordinances to Yisrael":
one revealed and one hidden, etc.;
they give the revealed things, etc."
is the level of the unlearned,
and Yisrael is the Torah scholar,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בָּבָא מְצִיעָא דַּף לג, ב)
"'And to the house of Yaakov their sins' (Yeshayahu 58:1), etc.
for whom willful sins are like errors, etc."
And the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He,
and read as the Name of Lordship;
alludes to His Godliness, may His Name be blessed;
and this all of Yisrael have
that there is a Creator of the world
and they fear Me out of faith,
and do His will, may He be blessed;
and this is "He tells His words to Yaakov":
that they give him the commandments of the Torah;
and this is also for the unlearned,
that he do what he was commanded;
and this is the matter of hearing:
that they hear what Hashem Yisbarach commands
And "His statutes and ordinances to Yisrael"
is the secrets of the Torah;
is that it be engraved in the heart;
the hidden aspect of the Torah,
for the words of Torah are engraved in the heart
and "the heart of the fool" is driven out
is the sensing of the reasons of the Torah,
this is one who reveals things
that the Ancient of Days concealed, etc.;
these are the reasons of the Torah"
And the matter of putting "we will do" before "we will hear":
that they would do before hearing
but how would they know what to do?
that Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
and from where did he know this?
Only from his great effort and toil
and this is the whole Torah
And the Zohar calls the six hundred thirteen mitzvos
for how to reach the perception of
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And this is what they said of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him:
and they would flow with Torah"
and he perceived all six hundred thirteen counsels.
And likewise all that the Sages innovated
are the words of the living God,
and over rabbinic mitzvos we bless
"Who has sanctified us with His mitzvos and commanded us";
and they perceived on their own
But then, at the standing at Mount Sinai,
when they put "we will do" first,
for they were on a great level
which is why they were then compared to an apple tree,
like the Holy One, blessed be He
they could perceive on their own
which are the clusters and the Torah scholars;
is the level of "His words to Yaakov,"
And the levels of love and fear
is the level of Knesses Yisrael,
which is called "a woman who fears Hashem,"
one brings fear into his heart,
שֶׁמֶּלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים עוֹמֵד עָלָיו כוּ׳
that the King of kings stands over him, etc.;
And this is Yisrael, hidden and revealed,
just as the Holy One, blessed be He,
which is the Name Havayah and the Name of Lordship;
and from the Name of Lordship comes fear
and from the Name Havayah comes love,
the secret of Ze'ir and Nukva,
the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah.
וְאַהֲבָה בָּא רַק מִצַּד הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
And love comes only from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
it is said in the singular,
for then they were of one will;
that is, as they said (in the Mechilta)
עַל פָּסוּק (שְׁמוֹת יט, ב) וַיִּחַן וְגוֹ׳
on the pasuk (Shemos 19:2) "And he encamped, etc.":
and now they were not on this level;
And therefore they were then called
then Hashem Yisbarach too is so toward them.
from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
and afterward honoring father and mother,
indicating that there is holiness in the body;
And here, where they were not on this level,
through the arousal from below, in fear.
And we find in the Gemara (Kiddushin 31b):
He shall not sit in his place, etc.
וְהַיְינוּ מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה וּמִצְוַת לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה
and these are positive and negative commandments,
For besides that father and mother
to the holiness of the soul;
and in the book Asarah Maamaros:
that the souls of the parents
are a mazal for the children;
a surrounding light for the son;
and this is the holiness of Kesser,
for Ayin is the mazal of Yisrael.
And likewise shame, which is fear,
"'And so that His fear may be (Shemos 20:17)
it is rooted in Yisrael from their forefathers;
it is known that his forefathers did not stand
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר רַבָּן יוֹחָנָן בֶּן זַכַּאי
as Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai said
"Would that the fear of Heaven be upon you
like the fear of flesh and blood"
for one who sins against flesh and blood,
And because from father and mother
therefore He commanded to fear them,
and their fear is equated with the fear of the Omnipresent;
that fear comes to the children
is because they bore the body in holiness,
in the likeness of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah.
And therefore he said of his mother:
And it is brought in sefarim
in the name of the holy Rav,
may the memory of the righteous and holy be a blessing,
that from the side of man is fear,
and love is from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
for "it is the way of a man
when they were on the level of love,
the mitzvah of Shabbos is written first,
from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
and after it honoring father and mother,
for from the side of the father is the drawing down of love.
which was said in the plural,
which does not allude to love
but only to the level of fear,
it began with the fear of father and mother,
for from her side comes fear
and afterward the mitzvah of Shabbos,
which is from the side of Hashem Yisbarach.
that is from the side of man
"What does Hashem your God ask of you
one will merit to come to the level of love
and to the holiness of Shabbos,
from the side of Hashem Yisbarach.
